entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Our master has an important matter to[n]discuss with you. Heed his words well.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: First, I'd like to congratulate you for[n]expelling the one proud of their greed...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...Or so I'd like to say, but something odd[n]seems to have happened.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, what of the general public?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, don't you sense it?[n]The malicious will of another...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It seems a contingency has occurred.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: At this rate, your rehabilitation cannot[n]be completed... though I doubt that[n]will be the case.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I truly look forward to seeing how you[n]overcome this predicament...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Time's up, Inmate! Hurry up and return[n]to your world!
I feel like my bond with Igor[n]is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок з Ігорем[n]стає глибшим...
